question: Consider the matrices $$A=\begin{bmatrix}2 & -1 & 0\end{bmatrix},\quad B=\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ 0 \\ -2\end{bmatrix},\quad C=\begin{bmatrix}4 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2\end{bmatrix},\quad D=\begin{bmatrix}5 & 0 \\ 0 & 5\end{bmatrix}.$$ Identify the applicable type or types of each matrix from row matrix, column matrix, square matrix, diagonal matrix and scalar matrix. Justify your answer.
explanation:
Matrix $A$
$A$ has only one row, so it is a row matrix.
Matrix $B$
$B$ has only one column, so it is a column matrix.
Matrix $C$
$C$ has equal numbers of rows and columns and all off-diagonal entries are zero. Hence, it is a square matrix and a diagonal matrix.
Matrix $D$
$D$ is square, all off-diagonal entries are zero, and all diagonal entries are equal to $5$. Hence, it is a square matrix, a diagonal matrix and a scalar matrix.

options.A: $A$: column; $B$: row; $C$: square and scalar; $D$: square and diagonal
options.B: $A$: row; $B$: column; $C$: square and diagonal; $D$: square, diagonal and scalar
options.C: $A$: row and square; $B$: column and square; $C$: scalar; $D$: identity
options.D: $A$: row; $B$: column; $C$: square, diagonal and scalar; $D$: square and diagonal only
